input echo retired (2026-10-12): the hand-typed script_outputs['current_trade.json'] = {'type': 'FUT', 'instrument_type': 'FUT'} stub every one of the 31 seeded records carried is removed. It was redundant and contradictory, not evidence: the only reader was gate 1's option-instrument probe, which falls back to the record's own `instrument` field, while the stage-12 replay is fed the proof row's recorded_artifacts and its pinned replay_inputs.canonical_trade — and 36 of the proof root's 46 canonical fixtures state instrument_type CASH, so the stub asserted a value the recorded input contradicts. Retiring it restores the E1 rule it violated (a payload a gate reads must be a recording, never an extracted subset typed into the dataset), and tests/run_evals.py check_payload_coverage fails the run on any payload a record carries with no recorded artifact behind it. Curators must not write it back (tests/evals/curate.py, tests/evals/pin_legacy_records.py).

distribution_verified=true: all 52 records are present and every class count matches class_counts_expected (flipped by tests/evals/seed_distribution_records.py when the tenth institutional_distribution row was authored).

option_probes: 5 authored Univest-style option pastes (CE/PE/OPT/CALL/PUT) seeded in the top-level `option_probes` roster as gate 1's stage-0 test cases (docs/agents/evals.md §2.1). They are AUTHORED PARSER INPUTS, disclosed as such — never sourced recommendations and never hazard measurements — and they are not trades: stage 0 rejects them before a canonical current_trade.json exists and the proof root pins no option scenario, so the frozen 52-trade quota, the class counts and distribution_verified are untouched. Gate 1 replays each paste live through scripts/0_ingest_reco.py and grades exit 2 + ERR_OPTIONS_PROHIBITED with no canonical payload (ADR-001, TICK-001 §3); meta.option_probes_expected governs the roster size.

REF-001..REF-005 are authored stage-0 *refusal* probes, not trades: input to the ingestion gate, disclosed as authored and counted by meta.refusal_probes_expected. They exercise ADR-001's closed instrument domain ("only Equities and Futures are permitted") at the two shapes the option-token gate cannot name: an option written with look-alike letters (Cyrillic/Greek/mixed) and an invented or un-aliased label (NFO, FUTURES). Each declares the refusal it must reproduce (exit 2, ERR_INSTRUMENT_UNRECOGNIZED, no canonical payload) and is replayed live by the Unrecognized Instrument Guardrail; the code is deliberately not ERR_OPTIONS_PROHIBITED, so a paste the gate never classified as an option cannot inflate the option rejection rate. No class count, census cell or distribution_verified claim is touched.

58 of 58 records: all seven classes are seeded and every class count matches class_counts_expected (distribution_verified=true). The three geometry classes (clean_bullish 15/15, inverted_rr 10/10, tight_stop 5/5) carry recorded stage-1/2 evidence over their pinned <=T_rec tape; the two hazard classes (pledge_hazard 5/5, earnings_hazard 7/7) are views of the frozen catalog's own hazard rows (business_test_cases.md §3) with recorded stage-6 evidence over an authored, disclosed bundle — the catalog's documented level verbatim where it states one and a disclosed value above the stated floor where it states only the inequality, statement blocks deliberately empty so stage 6 reports null ratios with missing_inputs naming every gap (E4: absence, never an invented filing); GB-2023-0003's legacy pledge payload was retired into recorded stage-6 evidence (tests/evals/retire_quarantine_records.py), so the E5 meter is 0 and gate 2 has no abstention left. institutional_distribution 10/10 (GB-2022-0033, GB-2022-0034, GB-2022-0035, GB-2022-0036, GB-2022-0037, GB-2022-0038, GB-2023-0039, GB-2023-0040, GB-2023-0041, GB-2023-0042): scan-authored by tests/evals/seed_distribution_records.py from NSE's own daily files — sec_bhavdata_full delivery % (EQ series) and the F&O bhavcopy's front-month open interest on each T_rec — admitting only sessions the files measure as price up, delivery < 25% and OI <= -5% (the class signature of docs/agents/evals.md §2) whose pinned tape then resolves LOSS under the frozen crisis geometry (T_rec open, 0.5x ATR stop, 2.0R target); every fixture discloses its source files' sha256 and a 20-session delivery window, and stage 5 is recorded through `5_institutional_flow.py --record`, so the class invariant (SHORT_COVERING_TRAP matrix, delivery < 25%, OI <= -5%) grades from proven bytes.
